stage: family screening (re-select representation family; do NOT rescue DINOv2-B)
thesis_served: 验证 anomaly-oriented representation/detector 是否在真实光照工业异常场景提供更稳定 headroom，为后续 illumination-consistency adaptation 提供更合适底座
why_now: E13 证明方法收益受 DINOv2-B ceiling 限制；先判断换 representation family 是否值得

exit.KEEP: 至少 1 个 family 进入 E14-B
exit.STOP: 关闭 E14，重新定义问题/场景

frozen_inputs.note: 每 family 用官方推荐 anomaly score；本轮不统一成 1-NN-max（family-level comparison）

F1.name: AnomalyDINO
F1.impl: DINOv2 448 L2-normalized kNN k=1, image score = mean_top1p (official)

F2.name: SoftPatch
F2.impl: WideResNet50 PatchCore + official WeightedGreedyCoresetSampler soft weighting (nearest/LOF)
F2.status: GO (E7 警告: 弱于 PatchCore)

F3.name: EfficientAD
F3.status: SKIP (本轮: 下载+训练成本, 第三优先)

staging.stage0: smoke Bird per GO family (10 checks, hard 20 min)
staging.stageA: Bird + Car (advance if mean(Bird,Car) dAUROC >= +0.010 OR mean dAP >= +0.010, AND any-cat dAUROC >= -0.015)
staging.stageB: Cube ceiling test (only for Stage A advanced families)

final_criteria.KEEP: 3-cat mean dAUROC >= +0.010 AND positive categories >= 2/3 AND Cube dAUROC >= 0 AND mean dAP >= +0.005
final_criteria.HOLD: 3-cat mean dAUROC >= +0.005 AND Cube dAUROC >= -0.005 AND mean dAP >= 0
